articles.title: Five Bright Planets to Spot in November
articles.summary: Saturn shines in the evening, Mars passes Jupiter on November 16, and brilliant Venus and Mercury light up November's dawn skies.

articles.title: Trees Use Hidden 'Muscles' to Straighten Themselves
articles.summary: Poplar trees can sense their own shape and grow special tension wood on opposite sides of a stem to pull themselves straight again.

articles.title: Scientists May Have Found a Lost Roman City in Austria
articles.summary: Surveys near Stein revealed a planned Roman city with an 8,000-seat amphitheater that may be Ptolemy's lost Claudivium, abandoned around 180 C.E.
